title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and your letter of 12 September.

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.17 (po:4500013023-10) through EUR 5.24 (po:4500013392-10), EUR 5.43 (po:4500013795-10) to EUR 5.45 (po:4500014455-10) between 2025-10-06 and 2026-09-24. That rise is already in our price.

Your letter of 6 July says your nickel and alloy needs are covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so we suggest a fixed price without a surcharge clause. In return we offer a longer commitment: 94,800 kg a year for 24 months. This gives you planning security for your capacity and purchasing. Our proposal is attached.

Could you also tell us about any cheaper variants, for example bar length or packaging?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Thank you for your proposal; we welcome the opportunity to secure a 24-month commitment.

As our fixed-price coverage for alloys concludes in March 2027, a 24-month agreement requires the inclusion of the AS-14404 index clause to manage long-term material risks. We have verified your historical purchase data and factored it into our revised offer of EUR 5.36 per unit.

Our revised Angebot stands at a price of €5.39 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €5.36 per unit. For this option, the package is a price of €5.36 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 – revised proposal for 24 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for taking our price history into account.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

We understand your concern about alloy risk after March 2027. A fixed price for the full term gives both sides a simple, predictable basis and removes the monthly surcharge calculations from your team's workload. Our attached proposal keeps 94,800 kg a year over 24 months with payment at 60 days, and we have moved our price towards you.

Could you tell us whether a cheaper variant, such as a different bar length or packaging, would lower your cost?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – revised proposal for 24 months
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

As our fixed-price coverage for alloys concludes in March 2027, we cannot offer a fixed price for a 24-month term and must insist on the AS-14404 index clause. Incorporating your requested 24-month contract and 60-day payment terms, we propose a revised price of EUR 5.28 per unit with the required index clause. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.28 per unit. 

Our offer stands at a price of €5.16 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. 

Our Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – revised proposal, fixed price for 24 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for the information on cheaper variants.

We have taken another clear step towards you in the attached proposal. It covers 94,800 kg a year for 24 months, with payment at 60 days. You have confirmed that your alloy needs are covered at fixed prices until March 2027. A fixed price for the full term therefore keeps the first part of the contract within your covered cost. It also saves your team the monthly surcharge calculations.

Your owner kindly offered in April to walk us through your calculation. We would welcome that if it helps us close the remaining gap.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – revised proposal, fixed price for 24 months
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your revised offer; however, we must retain the AS-14404 index clause for a 24-month contract as our fixed-price coverage ends in March 2027. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. 

We would be pleased to arrange a meeting to walk you through our calculation as you requested. To help close the gap, we have lowered our price to EUR 5.12 per unit for the 24-month term with 60-day payment. 

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Our complete Angebot stands at a price of €5.12 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. We are delighted to serve you and remain committed to supporting your needs with our broad range and reliable service. We look forward to continuing our successful partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
